articles.summary: MIDLAND, Texas, Nov. 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - New Era Energy Digital, Inc. (Nasdaq: NUAI) (“New Era” or the “Company”), a developer of next-generation digital infrastructure and integrated power assets, today announced that it expects to file its Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, before market open on Thursday, November 12, 2026. (Nasdaq: NUAI) (“New Era” or the “Company”), a developer of next-generation digital infrastructure and integrated power assets, today provided a business update for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. "Since our last quarterly update, we have contracted up to 207 MW of TCDC Phase 1 power, posted the required cash collateral and strengthened our balance sheet. With power availability expected in the third quarter of 2027, our focus is on our advanced negotiations for the Phase 1 lease and putting the financing and delivery arrangements in place,” said Charlie Nelson, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of New Era. “Responsible development has guided our approach from day one.
